contract: Compare each packet or SUP envelope and every typed composition, palette, object fragment and window field. The independent oracle encodes the public HDMV presentation graphics description at https://www.blu-ray.org.uk/2025/11/presentation-graphics.html and uses the pinned formats ffprobe only for container packet extraction. Includes raw clocks, complete segment bytes, payload lengths, unknown kinds and truncations.
